stem: Two cultivars in the same room show different leaf posture at the same time. What is the most appropriate technician interpretation?
choices: Record the cultivar-specific response and compare it with each cultivar's normal baseline before calling it abnormal
Change room conditions until both cultivars look identical
Ignore cultivar identity because genetics never affects morphology
rationale: Genotype can influence normal morphology and response. Observations should be compared with an appropriate baseline before being classified as abnormal.
